title: 第一卷 第11章 天地为乾坤那不如叫它第一卷 第12章 丹房第一位顾客
content_zh:
郸呈走后，陈玄劈了会儿柴。
之后又觉闲来无事，下午就去清理了炉灰。
应是此前郸师兄已清理了一阵，丹炉中残余炉灰并不多，花费一下午的时间就彻底清理干净，为避免出差错，他还特意检查了几遍。
直到日薄西山，天色朦胧，跑到郸呈那边借了根蜡烛，才回了自己的小屋。
关门，随手拉上门栓，又拿起不久前找来的大木棒抵在门后，这才安心走到床边，趴在地上从床底拉出陶罐。
这两日刚到丹房，还没来得及去看陶罐里的灵晶有无变化。
手伸进去一阵摸索，取出了那枚指甲盖大小的石子，放在手心仔细查看。
与他料想的一般，这颗原本白色的灵晶，此时散发微弱的蓝色光芒。
他早就知晓，灵晶亦有品质之分，分别以白、绿、蓝、紫、金五种光色，对应下品、中品、上品、极品与仙品。
按货币来讲，每种品质对应次一品质的十数，但由于极品灵晶较为罕见，会有一定程度的溢价。
至于仙品灵晶，已不可归类为货币，其本身极为稀有，用凤毛麟角形容毫不为过，加之蕴含的灵气堪比一个小型地脉，足以支撑一座小型宗门使用十年，已属于是可遇不可求的珍惜物品。
此时陈玄手中这颗，经陶罐‘加工’之后的下品灵晶，直接变为上品灵晶，由此推断，陶罐强化后的品质，大概率与物品本身品质有直接关联。
如金骨丹这种能直接改造筋骨的本就罕见，而白色灵晶属于是最常见的一类。
弄明白其中关节，又将灵晶丢进陶罐中。
他想看看将强化过的东西重新丢进去，能否进行‘二次加工’，以此摸清陶罐的‘机制’，想一份能把陶罐作用发挥到最大化的方案。
此时，陈玄已默认这个陶罐属于自己，毕竟修仙界讲究的就是个‘机缘’二字，何谓机缘？凭本事得来的就是机缘。
如他这般凭本事捡的，再如前辈赠送之物、以德斧人获取之物、偷……妙手偶得之物，都属于机缘。
就像仙界大佬‘好言相劝’后辈让出宝物，一般都是“小友，我观此物与我有缘”打头……
既是自己的东西，又是个宝物，当然要有个名字，总不能一直叫破罐子。
陈玄坐在床边，摸着下巴思索。

此罐既能直接强化物品属性，必是暗合天地运转之规律，天地即为乾坤，那不如就叫它……
“富贵罐！”
陈玄暗自点头。
叫乾坤罐有些太过招摇，光是名字就容易引人觊觎，很有可能引发‘罐子争夺战’，导致他英年早逝。
而且乾坤这两字有点太大了，他怕罐子压不住。
于是，最终决定取一个只有自己知道、心里暗戳戳叫的大名，就是‘乾坤罐’，而万一被外人问到，就说它的小名‘富贵’。
这般别人问起时，他也可有所解释，譬如‘以前穷怕了，想富起来’之类，当然这也不无道理，这陶罐子还真能让他‘富’起来。
不过谁又会在乎一个破罐子的名字呢……
总不会真有人闲来无事问他：你盛水的缸叫什么名字吧……到那时怕是对方已经探查到罐子跟脚，名字什么的都不重要了。
取贱名也就是聊以慰藉罢了。
夜幕渐沉。
陈玄点燃蜡烛放在床头，从怀中掏出郸师兄给他的手抄炼气法本，借着烛光翻开第一页。
只是刚看了一眼，脸颊就不断抽搐。
这蚂蚁爬一样的字，到底写的是什么东西啊？
“郸师兄这字写得实在是……一言难尽。”
捧着书离得烛光近了些，一字一句仔细看完了第一页，还好大部分能看明白，只是极个别内容要结合前后文猜测。
content_en:
After Dan Cheng left, Chen Xuan chopped firewood for a while.
Afterwards I felt free and had nothing to do, so I went to clean the ashes in the afternoon.
It must be that Senior Brother Dan had cleaned it for a while before, and there was not much ash left in the alchemy furnace. It took him an afternoon to clean it completely. To avoid making mistakes, he also checked it several times.
It wasn't until the sun set and the sky became hazy that I ran to Dancheng to borrow a candle and then returned to my hut.
After closing the door and pulling the bolt, he picked up the big wooden stick he found not long ago and put it against the back of the door. Then he walked to the bed with peace of mind, lay on the ground and pulled out the clay pot from under the bed.
I just arrived at the alchemy room these two days, and I haven't had time to see if there are any changes in the spiritual crystals in the clay pot.
He put his hand in and fumbled around for a while, then took out the stone the size of a fingernail, placed it in the palm of his hand and examined it carefully.
As he expected, this originally white spiritual crystal was now emitting a faint blue light.
He has known for a long time that spiritual crystals also have qualities, with five light colors: white, green, blue, purple, and gold, corresponding to low-grade, medium-grade, top-grade, top-grade, and fairy-grade.
In monetary terms, each quality corresponds to tens of the next quality, but since top-quality spiritual crystals are relatively rare, there will be a certain premium.
As for the Immortal Spirit Crystal, it can no longer be classified as currency. It is extremely rare in itself. It is no exaggeration to describe it as rare. In addition, the aura it contains is comparable to a small earth vein, which is enough to support a small sect for ten years. It is already a rare and rare item.
At this time, the low-grade spiritual crystal in Chen Xuan's hand, which had been 'processed' by the pottery pot, directly turned into a high-grade spiritual crystal. From this, it can be inferred that the enhanced quality of the pottery pot is most likely directly related to the quality of the item itself.
Pills like the Golden Bone Pill that can directly transform muscles and bones are rare, and white spiritual crystals are the most common type.
After figuring out the joints, he threw the spiritual crystal into the clay pot.
He wanted to see if he could perform 'secondary processing' by throwing the strengthened things back in, so as to understand the 'mechanism' of the clay pot and come up with a plan that could maximize the pot's effect.
At this time, Chen Xuan had already acquiesced that this clay pot belonged to him. After all, the word "chance" is what the world of immortality is about. What is chance? What comes with ability is opportunity.
Things like what he picked up based on his own ability, things that were given to him by his predecessors, things that were acquired through virtue, things that were stolen... and things that were accidentally obtained by a skilled hand, all belong to chance.
Just like a big boss in the fairy world who 'persuades the younger generation to give up treasures with kind words', he usually starts with "Little friend, I think this thing is destined for me"...
It is both my own thing and a treasure, so of course it needs a name. It cannot always be called a broken jar.
Chen Xuan sat on the edge of the bed, touching his chin and thinking.
Since this jar can directly strengthen the properties of items, it must coincide with the laws of the movement of heaven and earth. Heaven and earth are the universe, so why not just call it...
"Wealth Jar!"
Chen Xuan nodded secretly.
Calling him Qiankun Jar is a bit too ostentatious. The name alone can easily attract people to covet him, and it is likely to trigger a 'war for jars' and lead to his untimely death.
Moreover, the words "Qian Kun" were a bit too big, and he was afraid that the jar wouldn't be able to hold them down.
So, I finally decided to give it a famous name that only I knew and secretly called out in my heart, which was 'Qiankun Jar'. If anyone asked me about it, I would just say its nickname was 'Fugui'.
When others ask about it, he can give an explanation, such as, "I was afraid of being poor before and wanted to get rich." Of course, this is not unreasonable. This clay pot can really make him "rich."
But who cares about the name of a broken jar...
There's no way someone would ask him casually: What's the name of the tank you hold water in? By then, I'm afraid the other party will have already found the bottom of the tank, and the name won't matter anymore.
Taking a cheap name is just for comfort.
Night falls.
Chen Xuan lit a candle and placed it on the bedside. He took out the handwritten Qi Refining Technique given to him by Senior Brother Dan from his arms and opened the first page by the candlelight.
Just after taking a look, his cheeks kept twitching.
This ant crawlsThe same characters, what do they say?
"Senior Brother Dan, the word "Senior Brother" is really... difficult to describe in one word."
Holding the book closer to the candlelight, I carefully read the first page word for word. Fortunately, I could understand most of it, but some of the content had to be guessed based on the context.
